title: Staleness Computation
description: The staleness module documentation on caption generation and time formatting.
body: PRD §7.4's second caption line: crypto-primitives.sign changed 2h ago. Re-review required — built from the Staleness mark stale_cascade writes onto a node's stale field. The elapsed time is never stored, so it is computed here, at draw time, per PRD §0.4.
